pages.text: $(#4B0082)💢 Cursed Blood Boiling · Endless Battle Fury ⚔️$()$(br2)$(l)$(#9370DB)「Drink this sorcery extract, and mortal flesh shall bear the rage of ancient curses」$()$(br)When the $(#808080)Soul-Devouring Iron Blade$()’s murderous will, $(#50C878)Emerald Arcane Core$()’s raw power, $(#FFFFFF)Altar Wool$()’s purity, and $(#FF4500)Blood-Cursed Scarlet Bloom$() complete a $(l)slaughter sacrifice$() within the $(#483D8B)Cursed Ritual Cauldron$()—this forbidden war elixir shall $(l)transform muscles into weapons of destruction$().

$(#4B0082)▌ Threefold Curse of Wrath $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF0000)🔥 Frenzied Pulse$()$(br)Fists explode with $(#FF4500)magma fissures$() upon impact.$(br2)$(l)$(#9370DB)🌀 Endless Battle Will$()$(br)Strength persists for $(#50C878)three days and nights$().$(br2)$(l)$(#483D8B)⚡ Overcharged Curse Energy$()$(br)$(#4B0082)Runic circuits$() appear on the skin, amplifying combat output.

$(br2)$(#50C878)▌ Ritual of the Curse $()$(br)- Slay a $(#FF4500)Blazing Construct$() with an $(#808080)Iron Sword$() to obtain $(#8B0000)Soul-Devouring Iron Essence$().$(br)- Grind $(#50C878)Emeralds$() into $(#32CD32)Emerald Stardust$() and filter it through $(#FFFFFF)Wool Mesh$().$(br)- Inscribe $(#4B0082)ancient war curses$() onto the cauldron walls using $(#FF4500)Blood-Cursed Scarlet Bloom$().$(br)- Chant the $(#9370DB)Slaughter Mantra three times$() while mixing.$(br2)$(#FF0000)※$() The brew is complete when $(#4B0082)purple hex flames$() rise and $(#FFD700)phantom weapons$() manifest.

$(br2)$(#483D8B)『 Forbidden Sorcery Manuscript 』$()$(br)Blood-stained parchment records:$(br)'This drink holds:$(br)- The slaughter memory of $(#808080)a hundred-kills iron blade$().$(br)- The millennia-old arcane power of $(#50C878)Emeralds$().$(br)- The $(#FF4500)bloodlust$() contained within Scarlet Bloom.$(br)For those who thirst for war, their flesh shall become $(#4B0082)a tireless war machine$(),$(br)but every $(#9370DB)1 second$(), they must pay a $(#8B0000)life toll$().$(br)When $(#FFD700)phantom weapons$() fade, $(br)if they do not replenish $(#32CD32)Emerald Essence$() in time, $(br)their blood and flesh shall be $(#696969)forever petrified$()…'
